verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents an Azure feature that schedules or runs automations autonomously. The closest items are user-built building blocks: unattended curl scripts, the CLI, and declarative IaC templates. A community complaint names Azure Functions but does not document background or scheduled execution, and budget alerts are an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
